purpose: Compare the fixed structural HMM with the official Pfam PF00014 reference on identical existing evaluation proteins
primary_reference_rule: Best-domain bit-score cutoff selected solely by validation MCC; midpoint of widest maximum-MCC interval, with higher midpoint breaking equal-width ties
structural_model_rule: Original fixed best-domain score >=17.2 bits; no threshold retuning
secondary_reference_rule: Published Pfam gathering cutoffs: sequence score >=sequence GA and best-domain score >=domain GA; available values read from downloaded model
score_precision: One decimal as written in HMMER tblout, matching existing report
membership: Existing expanded validation and test assignments, unchanged; reviewed nonfragment Swiss-Prot2026_03; PF00014 label unchanged
limits: Existing benchmark already inspected; this is a reference-model comparison, not new external validation
PF00014 labels derive from Pfam annotation, so comparison measures annotation agreement and favors that reference definition
Pfam model seed overlap with evaluation data not assumed absent
Similarity and retrospective limitations of original benchmark remain
No claim of equivalence from one dataset or superiority from training sequence count alone
